research_item_name: Risk watchlist and key monitoring variables
source_title: Policy, Macro Conditions and Cost of Ownership Evidence Pack
Domestic Demand, Wholesale and Export Split Evidence Pack
Powertrain and Price-Band Migration Evidence Pack
Vehicle Category and Class Structure Evidence Pack
TOP15 Representative Models and Product Lifecycle Evidence Pack
Brand Blocs and Competitive Landscape Evidence Pack
published_or_observed_at: Research batches A and B validated on 2026-07-20
evidence_excerpt: Domestic retail declined more sharply than wholesale in May, while export was 35% of manufacturer passenger-vehicle sales; domestic demand and export must therefore be monitored separately.
A00 class declined 54.9% year on year in May, while C+ declined 3.7%; entry-market and higher-class risks differ materially.
The 2026 policy rule supports qualified renewals but the net conversion effect by price band and region is unmeasured.
Selected TOP15 models contain both large negative sample movements in established nameplates and no-comparable entrants with rank changes.
scope_and_caliber: Pilot risk framework for the 2026 China passenger-vehicle market. It converts validated May facts into monitoring rules. Management thresholds are provisional control rules, not statistically estimated causal thresholds.
metric_value_and_unit: May domestic retail: -22.1% YoY; May wholesale: -4.6% YoY
May export: 35% of manufacturer passenger-vehicle sales
TOP15 selected model movements are measured in 10^4 units
metric_type: Monthly market, channel, policy and TOP15 monitoring indicators.
comparison_period: May 2026 versus May 2025, with future monitoring on monthly and rolling two-month windows.
contribution_or_rank_change: TOP15 signals identify monitored candidate models but do not quantify full-market contribution or a causal share of risk.
segment_definition: Risk indicators are grouped into domestic demand, entry-level structure, product-cycle/competitive disruption, policy conversion and evidence freshness.
structure_change: The validated evidence indicates a differentiated risk profile rather than a single market-cycle risk: domestic retail, A00 entry products, established MPV nameplates and export reliance require separate watchlists.
representative_models: Examples for monitoring: Seagull, Qin PLUS and Hongguang MINI EV in sedans; Xingyue L and no-comparable SUV entrants; Buick GL8, Denza D9, WEY Gaoshan and ZEEKR 009 in MPVs.
lifecycle_event: Only verified product events may be added to the watchlist. Existing research confirms a ZEEKR 009 May facelift/launch event but does not assign sales causality.
overall_judgement: The immediate strategic risk is not simply lower market volume. It is the possibility of making decisions from the wrong signal: treating export-supported wholesale as domestic demand, treating vehicle class as price band, or treating a product event as proven model causality. The watchlist is designed to block those errors while identifying where additional data can change a decision.
observed_fact: May domestic retail, entry A00, MPV and several established TOP15 nameplates showed material weakness, while SUVs, C+ and selected new/no-comparable models were relatively resilient or changed rank quickly.
causal_mechanism: Each risk is evaluated as a monitored condition rather than a declared cause. A trigger only tells the agent to seek additional internal and external evidence before changing the market recommendation.
confidence_level: High for monitored facts; medium for risk prioritisation; low for threshold calibration until more months and regional data are available.
alternative_explanations: Seasonality, data-scope differences, model aggregation, temporary supply constraints, incentives, regional conditions and prior-year base effects can change each indicator without reflecting a lasting strategic risk.
competitive_set: Domestic retail versus export flows; entry A00 versus higher classes; established versus no-comparable TOP15 models; Chinese-brand versus mainstream joint-venture blocs.
competitive_advantage_or_barrier: No durable advantage is assumed from the current evidence. Relative resilience is a monitoring signal that requires product, price, channel and user validation.
configuration_threshold: [uncertain] Configuration-based risk triggers require model configuration, user preference and transaction data not present in the current pilot.
pricing_and_profit_signal: [uncertain] No common transaction-price, incentive-cost or profit series is available for calibrated margin-risk thresholds.
target_user_segment: [uncertain] The current watchlist is market-level and does not yet segment risks by household, age, city tier or purchase purpose.
purchase_motivation_and_pain_points: [uncertain] User motivations must be supplied by interviews, survey labels and channel records before they become risk drivers.
purchase_barrier: Potential barriers include eligibility, financing, charging and product fit, but their importance is not measured in this research stage.
channel_signal: Required monthly inputs are retail, wholesale, export, inventory, orders, cancellations, transaction price, policy applications and approval ageing at brand-model-region level.
opportunity_or_risk_grade: Risk-monitoring framework: active. It does not issue a final market-entry grade by itself.
recommended_action: Use the watchlist as a pre-report and pre-decision gate. When a trigger occurs, require a source-backed explanation or downgrade the conclusion to a pending hypothesis.
regional_capacity_or_channel_action: Hold regional capacity reallocation until the domestic-retail, inventory and order indicators are available by region. Export demand must use a separate utilisation scenario.
decision_condition_and_trigger: Provisional triggers: two consecutive months of domestic retail decline materially worse than wholesale; export share above the company-defined planning tolerance while domestic retail weakens; A00 decline worse than 40% for two months; major TOP15 rank change without verified product-event data; missing or stale evidence for a claimed driver. These are review triggers, not automatic decisions.
next_verification: Calibrate thresholds from at least 12 monthly observations, regional transaction data and business tolerance for inventory, utilisation, price and profitability.
data_quality_status: Passed as a rule-based pilot framework; not calibrated for automatic production decisions.
data_gap_or_conflict: No historical threshold distribution, region-level pipeline, price/profit series or user-data linkage was provided. All numerical trigger values remain provisional.
claim_boundary: The watchlist can flag where to investigate. It cannot label a market as declining, attractive or unprofitable without the corresponding validated evidence.

risk_register.risk: Domestic retail is masked by export-supported wholesale
risk_register.indicator: Domestic retail YoY, wholesale YoY, export share and inventory
risk_register.action: Separate China demand decision from export capacity scenario

risk_register.risk: Entry-market contraction is generalised as all-NEV weakness
risk_register.indicator: A00/A0/A/B/C+ retail, price band and TOP15 model movement
risk_register.action: Require price and product evidence before allocating entry-market resources

risk_register.indicator: No-comparable flag, rank movement, launch date, delivery start and transaction price
risk_register.action: Classify as ramp observation; prohibit year-on-year contribution claims

risk_register.risk: Policy rules are mistaken for measured demand impact
risk_register.indicator: Eligible applications, approval time, regional funding and conversion by price band
risk_register.cadence: Weekly during policy windows; monthly otherwise
risk_register.action: Keep policy impact as a hypothesis until conversion data is available
